# The French Citizens’ Convention on Climate in Parliamentary Discourse

## About this repository

This repository contains the R Markdown files used for the quantitative text analysis in my master's thesis on the French Citizens' Convention on Climate (CCC) in parliamentary discourse.

The files document the main steps of the analysis, from building the parliamentary debate corpus to analysing the salience of CCC-related policy themes and conducting robustness checks. The dictionaries used in the analysis are included in the R Markdown files.

## R Markdown files

The files are numbered to reflect the order of the analytical steps. However, each R Markdown file is self-contained and can be run indepedently, provided that the required XML source files are available and the file paths are adjusted accordingly.

| File | Main purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `1_full_corpus_annotated.Rmd` | Parse the source XML files, construct the speech corpus, assign temporal variables, and identify climate-policy-related speeches. |
| `2_dictionary_annotated.Rmd` | Develop and inspect the climate-policy, explicit CCC-reference, and CCC policy-theme dictionaries; examine matched texts. |
| `3_salience_annotated.Rmd` | Calculate and visualise the prevalence of explicit CCC references and references to associated policy themes across periods and years. |
| `4_keyness_annotated.Rmd` | Compare vocabulary across the pre- and post-CCC periods using corpus-based keyness analysis; inspect selected keywords in context. |
| `5_robustness check_annotated.Rmd` | Compare results obtained using the original and stricter policy-theme dictionaries at period and year levels. |
| `6_cluster_robustness_annotated.Rmd` | Examine policy-theme references and robustness across six thematic clusters. |

## Data source

The analysis uses French National Assembly parliamentary debate transcripts from the 15th and 16th legislatures. The original XML files are availabe from the following official websites:

- 15th legislature: https://data.assemblee-nationale.fr/archives-anterieures/archives-15e/debats-en-seance-publique
- 16th legislature:
https://data.assemblee-nationale.fr/archives-16e/debats

Both websites were accessed on 25 September 2026. The data are made available under the Licence Ouverte / Open Licence.

The original XML files are not included in this repository. They need to be obtained from the websites above. The file paths in the R Markdown fiels may need to be adjusted before running the code.

## Scope

This repository contains the code for the quantitative analysis only. The qualitative framing analysis is documented in the thesis appendix.
